description: Admin management surface: ManageTemplateUseCase port (create, edit->new version, activate version/rollback, list by type, get history, deactivate), request/response DTOs, service implementation delegating to the FEAT-002 persistence ports, and a TemplateAdminController under infrastructure/adapter/input/web/controller with full OpenAPI annotations (following findu-core's OfertaController pattern). Depends on FEAT-002 (persistence ports + versioning) and FEAT-001 (DTO/port packages, domain model).
steps: Create application/port/in/ManageTemplateUseCase.java with: TemplateResponse create(CreateTemplateRequest); TemplateResponse edit(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language, UpdateTemplateRequest) (creates a new version); TemplateResponse activateVersion(ActivateVersionRequest) (activate/rollback pointer); List<TemplateResponse> listByType(TemplateType tipo); List<TemplateVersionResponse> history(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language); void deactivate(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language). ResolveTemplateUseCase already added in FEAT-002.

Create application/dto/request: CreateTemplateRequest (codigo, tipo, language, bodyTemplate, variables, audiencia, + per-type optional fields: subject/contentType, waTemplateName, rabbitExchange/RoutingKey/Queue/eventType, title/routing, alert metadata) with jakarta.validation annotations (@NotBlank codigo, @NotNull tipo, @NotBlank language, @NotBlank bodyTemplate); UpdateTemplateRequest (editable fields, same validation); ActivateVersionRequest (codigo, tipo, language, version @NotNull).

Create application/dto/response: TemplateResponse (full active-version view incl. version + per-type fields + audiencia) and TemplateVersionResponse (version, active, createdAt, createdBy, bodyTemplate) for history listings. Add a mapper (application/util or static factory) domain<->DTO.

Implement application/service/impl/TemplateAdminServiceImpl.java implementing ManageTemplateUseCase: validate request (reject unknown/missing per-type required fields using the FEAT-002 VariableValidator where relevant), build a NotificationTemplate domain object, and call TemplateRepositoryPort.createNewVersion / activateVersion / findByTipo / findHistory / deactivate. On create, set version baseline and audit fields (createdBy from request/header placeholder). Evict the relevant @Cacheable entry on edit/activate/deactivate so the send path sees the new active version.

Create infrastructure/adapter/input/web/controller/TemplateAdminController.java mapped at /api/v1/admin/templates (reactive, returning Mono/ResponseEntity consistent with existing controllers): POST (create, 201), PUT /{codigo}/{tipo}/{language} (edit -> new version), POST /activate (activate/rollback), GET ?tipo= (list by type), GET /{codigo}/{tipo}/{language}/history (version history), DELETE or PATCH /{codigo}/{tipo}/{language} (deactivate). Annotate every endpoint with @Tag/@Operation/@ApiResponses like findu-core's OfertaController. Constructor-inject ManageTemplateUseCase.

Add controller/service unit tests under src/test/java/.../application/service/impl and/or a @WebFluxTest for TemplateAdminController covering: create returns 201 and version 1; edit creates version 2 (verify createNewVersion called); activateVersion rollback path; list by type; history; deactivate. Mock the ManageTemplateUseCase / TemplateRepositoryPort.
Run '.\gradlew.bat build' and fix until BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
acceptance_criteria: ManageTemplateUseCase exposes create/edit/activateVersion/listByType/history/deactivate and lives in application/port/in; implementation in application/service/impl.
Request DTOs carry jakarta.validation constraints; response DTOs expose version + per-type fields; a domain<->DTO mapper exists.

TemplateAdminController at /api/v1/admin/templates exposes POST create, PUT edit (new version), POST activate (rollback), GET list-by-type, GET history, DELETE/PATCH deactivate, each with OpenAPI @Operation/@ApiResponses.
Edit creates a NEW version (never overwrites) and activate repoints to a chosen prior version; the send-path cache is evicted on mutations.
'.\gradlew.bat build' prints BUILD SUCCESSFUL with the new admin controller/service tests passing.

IN-PORT application.port.in.ManageTemplateUseCase: TemplateResponse create(CreateTemplateRequest); TemplateResponse edit(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language, UpdateTemplateRequest); TemplateResponse activateVersion(ActivateVersionRequest); List<TemplateResponse> listByType(TemplateType tipo); List<TemplateVersionResponse> history(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language); void deactivate(String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language). Implemented by application.service.impl.TemplateAdminServiceImpl (ctor: TemplateRepositoryPort, TemplateDtoMapper, CacheManager).

ENDPOINTS (infrastructure.adapter.input.web.controller.TemplateAdminController @RequestMapping /api/v1/admin/templates, reactive Mono<ResponseEntity>, @Tag 'Admin Plantillas', full @Operation/@ApiResponses):
- POST /api/v1/admin/templates -> create, 201, body CreateTemplateRequest, returns TemplateResponse.
- PUT /api/v1/admin/templates/{codigo}/{tipo}/{language} -> edit (new version), 200, body UpdateTemplateRequest.
- POST /api/v1/admin/templates/activate -> activateVersion/rollback, 200, body ActivateVersionRequest.
- GET /api/v1/admin/templates?tipo={TemplateType} -> listByType, 200, List<TemplateResponse>.
- GET /api/v1/admin/templates/{codigo}/{tipo}/{language}/history -> history, 200, List<TemplateVersionResponse>.
- DELETE /api/v1/admin/templates/{codigo}/{tipo}/{language} -> deactivate, 204.
Path var {tipo} binds to domain.enums.TemplateType (SMS/EMAIL/WHATSAPP/EVENTO/NOTIFICACION/ALERTA); {language} e.g. 'es'.

REQUEST DTOs (application.dto.request, Lombok @Builder, jakarta.validation): CreateTemplateRequest {@NotBlank codigo, @NotNull TemplateType tipo, @NotBlank language, @NotBlank bodyTemplate, List<String> variables, @Valid AudienceRequest audiencia, EMAIL: subject/contentType, WHATSAPP: waTemplateName, EVENTO: rabbitExchange/rabbitRoutingKey/rabbitQueue/eventType, NOTIFICACION: title + @Valid NotificationRoutingRequest routing, ALERTA: @Valid AlertMetaRequest alertMeta}. UpdateTemplateRequest = same editable fields (codigo/tipo/language from path), @NotBlank bodyTemplate. ActivateVersionRequest {@NotBlank codigo, @NotNull tipo, @NotBlank language, @NotNull Integer version}. Nested: AudienceRequest{AudienceMode modo, Map<String,Object> filtros, List<String> userIds}; NotificationRoutingRequest{condicion, canalSiActivo, canalSiInactivo}; AlertMetaRequest{AlertCategory categoria, pantallaDestino, titulo, ctaLabel, ctaAction, boolean cerrable, Integer prioridad, vigenciaDesde, vigenciaHasta, condicionAparicion, Integer tiempoDesaparicion}.

RESPONSE DTOs (application.dto.response): TemplateResponse (full active-version view: id, codigo, tipo, language, bodyTemplate, variables, version, active, AudienceResponse audiencia, createdAt/By, updatedAt/By, subject, contentType, waTemplateName, rabbit* , eventType, title, NotificationRoutingResponse routing, AlertMetaResponse alertMeta); TemplateVersionResponse {Integer version, boolean active, createdAt, createdBy, bodyTemplate} for history. Nested AudienceResponse/NotificationRoutingResponse/AlertMetaResponse mirror the domain VOs.

MAPPER application.util.TemplateDtoMapper (@Component): toDomain(CreateTemplateRequest), toDomain(codigo,tipo,language,UpdateTemplateRequest), toResponse(NotificationTemplate)->TemplateResponse, toVersionResponse(NotificationTemplate)->TemplateVersionResponse, with private VO converters.

SERVICE BEHAVIOR: create/edit set audit (createdBy/updatedBy = 'admin' placeholder, createdAt/updatedAt = Instant.now().toString()); edit preserves original createdAt/By from current v#ACTIVE. create & edit both delegate to TemplateRepositoryPort.createNewVersion (edit NEVER overwrites -> next version), then reload v#ACTIVE via findActive and map. activateVersion builds id CODE#TIPO#LANG and calls repo.activateVersion(id, version) (rollback), then reloads. listByType -> repo.findByTipo. history -> repo.findHistory(id). deactivate -> repo.deactivate(id). Per-type required-field validation (validatePerTypeFields): EMAIL requires subject; WHATSAPP requires waTemplateName; EVENTO requires rabbitExchange+rabbitRoutingKey; NOTIFICACION requires routing; ALERTA requires alertMeta.categoria; SMS only common fields. Missing -> InvalidTemplateException (400 via GlobalExceptionHandler).

CACHE EVICTION: on create/edit/activate/deactivate the service evicts cache 'notification-templates' with key exactly 'codigo#tipo#language' where tipo = TemplateType.toString() (matches TemplateServiceImpl @Cacheable key "#templateCode + '#' + #tipo + '#' + #language"). id for repo ops = codigo.toUpperCase()#tipo.name().toUpperCase()#language.toLowerCase() (same as NotificationTemplateItem.buildId).

SEED/DOCS NEEDS (FEAT-004): admin create writes v#1 + v#ACTIVE; TemplateResponse/version endpoints read v#ACTIVE and v# history. No new DynamoDB attributes beyond FEAT-002's NotificationTemplateItem schema. Controller is reactive (findu-core OfertaController is MVC/non-reactive, so OpenAPI style was copied but return types wrapped in Mono<ResponseEntity> to match this micro's DeviceController). Commit on branch feature/notif-template-engine.
